step: Build launch and patrol, then run tests in pinned ROS image
script:
image="$(cat docker-image.txt)"
docker run --rm \
  --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" \
  --mount "type=bind,source=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE,target=/work" \
  --workdir /work \
  "$image" bash -ec '
    source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash
    colcon build --symlink-install --packages-select turtle_bringup patrol
    source install/setup.bash
    test -f "$(ros2 pkg prefix turtle_bringup)/share/turtle_bringup/launch/sim.launch.py"
    python3 -m py_compile src/turtle_bringup/launch/sim.launch.py
    ros2 pkg executables patrol | grep -Fx "patrol patrol"
    python3 -m pytest src/patrol/test
  '
